applicability: Wilson score confidence interval checking whether a claimed classification accuracy is statistically supported by the declared test-set size
assumptions: test samples are independent and identically distributed
the test set is representative of the real deployment distribution
excluded: detection of data leakage between training/model-selection and test
uncertainty: Standard textbook inferential statistics (Wilson 1927); hand-verified before use (95/100 -> CI approx (0.888,0.978); 9/10 -> CI approx (0.596,0.982)).
limits_policy: An accuracy claim whose interval lower bound falls below the declared minimum is flagged as unsupported rather than accepted.
